snippet.title: Memo R.I.P. – Official Trailer 2 | Horror Card Game (2026)
snippet.description:
Memo R.I.P. is a first‑person card game with psychological horror, 4‑player multiplayer, integrated AI, and more than 900 dynamic scares.
This Trailer 2 shows, for the first time, the full gameplay flow: match → prison → boss → new map.

🟣 Main Features  
• 6 variants of the card game
• 36 characters with voices, curses, and personality
• AI that fills empty slots in online matches
• Vivox integration (real‑time voice chat)
• 20 levels of progression
• 5 bosses and 5 new maps
• The Prison: a map inspired by PT / Visage
• 900 dynamic scares with unique entities per room
• Skull‑based economy for unlocking cosmetics
• Available in 44 languages

🟣 Demo available on Steam  
Includes 2 variants, 1 character, early progression, and a preview of The Exiled Prison.
Play it for free here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4697170/Memo_RIP/

🟣 Add it to your wishlist  
Your wishlist helps the launch tremendously.

🟣 Follow us for more content  
TikTok: @divine.magic.games
Twitter: @DivineMagicGames

Thank you for supporting Memo R.I.P.
This is just the beginning.
